Selected, not invented.

This prototype uses deterministic matching and prewritten text. The same posting, emphasis and evidence version produce the same selection.

It runs in your browser. Your posting is not sent to a model, stored or included in the resume.

What the match can tell you

Keywords connect a requirement to related career evidence. They do not confirm seniority, minimum years, credentials or every part of a requirement. Review the source and any qualification notes.

SOAP/XML, REST and scheduled table-backed publish/subscribe solution review are supported. JSON standards and broker-based or real-time implementation are not established. Independent NEXUS work stays separate from employer experience.
